name: "All Hands on Deck" Room Service Cheese & Cracker Platter
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Room Service
whyItWorks: Famous complimentary 24-hour room service staple: aged cheddar, Swiss, Gouda/Babybel (~0g lactose) with plain water/Ritz-style crackers for zero-effort stateroom calories.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dial Room Service any time day or night and order "All Hands on Deck" (ask for extra plain crackers). Eat the aged hard/semi-soft cheeses and crackers; skip the red grape skins or blue cheese wedge if flaring.
watchOuts: Whole grape skins on the platter
Blue cheese wedge if sensitive to mold/soft cheeses
